name: Urban Leadership Fellows Program
org: Futures and Options with The Municipal Forum of New York
what_you_do: Work a paid six-week summer internship at a municipal finance company. You go to workshops and meet mentors in the field. You learn how money, government and public policy connect.
who_can_apply: New York City students who are about to graduate from high school. You like business, finance, government or public policy.
pay_detail: Paid summer internship. The hourly rate is not stated. At the end you get a book and technology stipend and can apply for college scholarships.
deadline_text: The application was closed when we read the page. No dates are posted. Use the interest form to be told when it opens.
how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form on the program page. You will be told when the application opens.
notes: The page says 930 students have been ULF interns since 1996 and alumni have received $1.7 million in scholarships. Rate and dates are not stated.
